tools.name: WebRead
tools.description: Read a public web page as clean article text. Send {"url":"https://..."} for one page at $0.002, or {"urls":["https://..."]} for up to 10 pages at $0.002 each. Plain fetch, no JavaScript.

tools.name: WebSearch
tools.description: Web search. Send {"query":"..."} and get ranked results with title, URL, domain, snippet, and description. Each result includes a POST /read call at $0.002.

tools.name: TokenSnapshot
tools.description: Base token info, ERC-20. Look up the name, symbol, decimals, total supply, and raw supply of a token on Base. Send a ticker such as USDC, or the contract address.

tools.name: SpotPrice
tools.description: Current ETH price in USD and BTC. Current USD price ETH, plus the 24 hour high, low, change, volume, and the time of the quote. An empty body returns ETH.

tools.name: CryptoPrice
tools.description: Token price. USD spot price for a ticker such as ETH, BTC, or SOL, with the 24 hour high, low, change, and volume. Send {"symbol":"ETH"}.

tools.name: Weather
tools.description: Current weather by city. Temperature, conditions, rain, wind, humidity, and the next hours. Send {"city":"London"}, or latitude and longitude.

tools.name: CoinGap
tools.description: Coin pair quote. Mid price and amount out for a have/want pair from the live USD price.

tools.name: GasBuffer
tools.description: Base gas price. Current base fee, priority fee tiers, ready-to-sign max fee, and what a 21000-gas transfer costs in ETH and USD.

tools.name: StablePeg
tools.description: Stablecoin peg. Live price and deviation in basis points for USDC, USDT, and DAI. An empty body returns all three.

tools.name: RouteOneHop
tools.description: One-hop route. The venue and slope for a have/want pair from the route table.

tools.name: SlippageCap
tools.description: Slippage cap. Largest order size that stays under a basis-point cap.

tools.name: SchemaGate
tools.description: Validate JSON keys and types. Send a schema of key to type name and the payload to check.

tools.name: HashMatch
tools.description: SHA-256 compare. Pass or fail a value against a sha256 hex digest.

tools.name: Checksum
tools.description: EIP-55 checksum. Send an address and get the checksummed form. A mixed-case address must already match.

tools.name: ReceiptAudit
tools.description: x402 receipt check. Confirms a receipt has a network and an amount. Does not settle it again.

tools.name: AllowlistStamp
tools.description: Allowlist check. Pass or fail an address against a named list stored for this service.

tools.name: CrashLocker
tools.description: Store one JSON document up to 8KB and return its locker id.

tools.name: LockerRead
tools.description: Read one stored JSON document by its locker id.

tools.name: SnapshotDiff
tools.description: Diff two stored JSON documents at the top level.

tools.name: BannerMint
tools.description: Store an SVG banner and return its public URL.

tools.name: ReceiptArchive
tools.description: Append one receipt line for an agent id.

tools.name: AgentCard
tools.description: Build an agent card from a name, a purpose, and a tool list.

tools.name: LlmsTxt
tools.description: Build an llms.txt document from a name, a purpose, and links.

tools.name: McpManifest
tools.description: Build a small MCP manifest from a name and a tool list.

tools.name: RegistryList
tools.description: Add one guest card to the public directory for 24 hours.

tools.name: DiscoverQuery
tools.description: Find tools on this service by need, such as price, proof, or storage.

tools.name: BudgetSplit
tools.description: Split a dollar budget by weight without passing each item's cap.

tools.name: RetryPlan
tools.description: Choose retry, pay, or abort from an HTTP status.

tools.name: DeadlineGuard
tools.description: Go or stop by comparing a deadline with the current time.

tools.name: UsdSatsQuote
tools.description: USD to satoshis. Convert dollars into USDC atomic units and BTC sats.

tools.name: DuplicateGuard
tools.description: Remember a buyer and resource for the rest of the day. The first call is new.

tools.name: FreshNonce
tools.description: Transaction nonce on Base. Next nonce for an address. Send chain ethereum for Ethereum.

tools.name: ClockSkew
tools.description: Clock skew in seconds between a client unix time and this service.

tools.name: BlockLag
tools.description: Block number. Latest block on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, or Polygon, with the block time and how far behind a client block is.

tools.name: WindowOpen
tools.description: Open or closed for a unix start and end window.

tools.name: IdempotencyKey
tools.description: The same idempotency key for a buyer and resource for 24 hours.

tools.name: FieldPick
tools.description: Keep only the named keys from a JSON document.

tools.name: UnitScale
tools.description: Scale an integer amount from one decimal size to another.

tools.name: AddressPack
tools.description: Pack a chain id, address, and memo into one object.

tools.name: HexUtf8
tools.description: Convert hex to UTF-8, or UTF-8 to hex.

tools.name: SizeCap
tools.description: Drop keys until a JSON document fits under a byte cap.

tools.name: TwoQuoteMin
tools.description: Pick the smaller of two quotes.

tools.name: FeeAdd
tools.description: Add a fee in basis points, rounded to the cent.

tools.name: MinFill
tools.description: Pass or fail an amount against a minimum fill.

tools.name: PairAllow
tools.description: Pass or fail a have/want pair against the allowed list.

tools.name: StaleQuote
tools.description: Fresh or stale by comparing a quote time with a max age.

tools.name: BannerPack
tools.description: Both SVG banner URLs and embeds for one tool id.

tools.name: WallSlice
tools.description: Five banner embeds for one tool group.

tools.name: CiteLine
tools.description: One machine-readable line for a tool id.

tools.name: RelayCard
tools.description: Store a forward pointer from a seen-by name to a registry URL.

tools.name: FreshList
tools.description: Tools and guest cards touched inside a recent hour window.

tools.name: BackupKey
tools.description: Latest backup object key and its age in seconds.

tools.name: RetryAfter
tools.description: Seconds to wait before retrying an HTTP status.

tools.name: FallbackUrl
tools.description: A sibling tool to call when this service's backup is old.

tools.name: HealthTicket
tools.description: Compact copy of the health check: tool count, backup age, and network.

tools.name: JournalTail
tools.description: Last receipt ids stored for a buyer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: WebRead, WebSearch · Private data: TokenSnapshot, CryptoPrice, CrashLocker, LockerRead, SnapshotDiff, LlmsTxt, FieldPick, SizeCap · Public sink: WebRead, WebSearch, TokenSnapshot, CryptoPrice, Weather, SchemaGate, Checksum, FreshNonce, RelayCard · Destructive: SizeCap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: WebRead, WebSearch · Private data: TokenSnapshot, CryptoPrice, CrashLocker, LockerRead, SnapshotDiff, LlmsTxt, FieldPick, SizeCap · Public sink: WebRead, WebSearch, TokenSnapshot, CryptoPrice, Weather, SchemaGate, Checksum, FreshNonce, RelayCard · Destructive: SizeCap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
